synthesizedFacts.fact: Rosacea is a common skin condition characterized by facial redness, burning, and pimple-like spots.
Over-the-counter treatments for rosacea include creams and gels with ingredients like ceramides, hyaluronic acid, niacinamide, mineral sunscreens, azelaic acid, and sodium sulfacetamide/sulfur.
Prescription treatments for rosacea may include metronidazole, brimonidine, oxymetazoline, and ivermectin.
Laser treatments can be used to reduce flushing and enlarged blood vessels in rosacea patients.
The National Rosacea Society provides a Seal of Acceptance for products that are unlikely to irritate sensitive rosacea skin.
